description: A full-length dark brown open robe with gold geometric patterned borders along the front edges, broad cuffs and hem. It is layered over a cream tunic with a short open neck and restrained tan-gold decoration at the neckline and front. A wide patterned ochre-brown woven-looking sash wraps the waist, with fringed ends hanging down the front. Cream trousers and brown ankle boots appear beneath the robes. The cloth has a matte textured finish; exact fibres are uncertain. No headgear, armor or weapons are present.
